text:
Priya: Quick sync post-launch. We need a 2-week stabilize wave focused on crash P0s, important P1s, a UX polish pass, and one low-risk perf improvement. Can owners call out "must-fix" vs "defer"?
Sam: Sentry shows 5 P0s and ~9 P1s. P0s are top priority. I'll own P0 triage + patch.
Miguel: I'll pick up the input jitter P1 but prefer it in the second week after hotfixes. Reduces rollout blast radius.
Jess: Proposed schedule: Day 0-2 emergency hotfix sprint (P0/P1 crash only), Day 3-10 polish + small improvements, Day 11-14 stabilization & cleanup. Canary between the two phases.
Priya: Acceptance criteria for hotfixes: reproducible test, no new e2e flakes, rollback runbook. Gate metrics: error rate, p95 latency, and memory.
Sam: Adding gate thresholds to the runbook:
``
error_rate <= baseline * 1.005
p95_latency <= baseline * 1.2
memory_usage <= 80% of prod pool
```
Ava: ACME requested a ranking tweak. Low risk but needs eval harness + A/B. Suggest we include as a 5% canary in polish if eval passes. I'll build the harness.
Miguel: I'll set up dashboards and alerts for rollout and smoke tests. Need signoff on thresholds.
Jess: I'll draft the canary policy and smoke checklist. @Miguel make sure alerts go to #release-war-room and page on infra regressions.
Sam: Are we feature-freezing tonight EOD PST? Engineers need heads-down to ship fixes.
Priya: Yes, freeze EOD PST. Call out any blockers now.
Miguel: No blockers.
Ava: None.
Jess: Creating canary policy PR now.
ops-bot: Scheduled deployment window: 2025-03-28T22:00Z (hotfix).
Priya: I'll update the roadmap doc with mini-epic slices and publish a checklist by 10:00am PST tomorrow. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
